newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FOCUS-Draft EU resolution links EMU with jobs.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Draft EU resolution links EMU with jobs.

text.p: A draft resolution on employment prepared by the Dutch European Union presidency to go with the EMU stability pact calls for stronger links between job creation and the single currency.
A translation of the draft document obtained by Reuters also reiterates that job creation remains primarily the responsibility of EU member governments.

The draft, designed to assuage the new French Socialist government's concern about the rigourous application of the budget pact, also calls for greater economic policy coordination between EU countries.
But another provision says economic stability is a way to create jobs.

French and German finance ministers, meeting in Poitiers, France on Friday, said they were making progress on refining the budget pact, a measure designed to keep public spending under control within monetary union.
"We're advancing," French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said following talks with German Finance Minister Theo Waigel during a Franco-German summit.
Waigel said while progress was being made, further work was needed.
Diplomats said it was unclear whether European Commission President Jacques Santer had proposed these resolutions to the French government on Thursday.

EU finance ministers will meet informally on Sunday evening in Amsterdam to discuss the resolution with the hope of reaching an agreement in time for a summit between heads of state on Monday and Tuesday.
